states.changed: A visitor meets seventeen written instructions of this house that a script can decide from Git, read against the full public history of its four repositories: one lane per instruction and practice, one cell per day opening to each file and commit, and reads that 171 of 8,098 bound items broke a limit, none a prohibition or a duty, and that only 39 break a limit in every reading of what a line and a word are.

A visitor now meets who saw first: one mark per broken limit, placed by the day it was committed and the days until anyone named it in writing, and reads that 8 of the 171 were named before the census, each by the practice that broke the rule, while the rest sit on the census line after a median of 28 days; then the architect's own record, one square per deed of the house's machines beyond or against their instructions in the site's decision log, grouped by who saw it first: the architect 13 and a session he set to look 9 of the 29 rows that say, the machines unbidden 7, nobody outside the house; each mark and square opens to its commit or its row.
